reviews.review:
Can't recomend purchasing at this stage. 

A great foundation, with seemingly a great, communicative team behind it, with lots of potential. Years of work ahead still. 

If you're happy to test and chat in the official discord, offering feedback and helping out - do support the devs. 

Still better than Back 4 Blood.

January 2024 Update:

Unfortunately, nothing has changed. The game still, fundamentally, isn't fun to play. Heartbreaking.

Experience was... OK. I understand the game is not finished. In my opinion, they really need to focus on the core gameplay and less on content right now. The experience with the first few levels was... meh. The art is GORGEOUS. 10/10. On the other hand, voice acting was seriously underwhelming, I don't know if it's a stylistic choice or what, but "I'm grabbed" would invoke panic, right? Instead we get a monotonic "I'm grabbed". Feels very bland. Lacks character.

IDK, the game has potential, sure. But lack of content is not the main issue with the game. The core game just doesn't feel "fun". It really needs polish. And I'm not even talking about the bot AI (which is... terrible). I'd be happier if there was just one campaign that was really fun right now.

I liked the weapons. They were fun, mostly. Recharging the weapons felt natural. Grenades everywhere was fun also, but had no "presence". Half the time I couldn't tell where my grenade was going. Maybe cut back on the number of grenade types and really focus the mechanics of those, get them right? I guess there's like... 5, right? Vortex, fire, impact, goo, and time slow? The fire grenade doesn't feel really useful, Idk but it just makes a small puddle of fire? I have no idea what the goo grenade does. Other grenades are pretty straightforward, I don't know when I'd use a time slow grenade.

Perks made no sense to me. I just didn't feel a big difference in the game play.

If I could message the devs, my feedback would be to find what you can scrap. Cut back features (I'd consider removing the perk system altogether maybe?). Nail the core experience. Go deep, then wide.

To my fellow steam-izens and left 4 dead fans, I'd say hold off a bit to play it. I'm going to wait for a bit to come back because right now I just did not have fun, and I really want this game to succeed.
Its just space themed Left 4 Dead 2 with new maps. I like Left 4 Dead 2.

-- LAUNCH DAY REVIEW -- 

I just can't recommend this game, it feels so hollow

I've just tried episode 5, going from early access, they've crammed down 4 levels into one level that on the guide says "30 minutes" as a rough estimate to complete but can be done easily in 15, it's feels rushed, you can walk through areas, the dialogue feels disjointed and the world feels empty

And that's a big issue with this game when compared to it's competition both new and old, the world building here feels non-existent

If the other episodes are still the same as before this update then most of my opinions on the game below stand to be the same

I've followed this game since it's announcement, got to be one of the testers before the early access started and I had high hopes for this game, sadly it didn't deliver, I hope the modding scene picks up to change that...


-- 23/12/2022 REVIEW UPDATE--

So we're about a year into the release of early access for The Anacrusis and it's painful for me to say but, this game is not in a state that I'd recommend buying... yet

I think The Anacrusis still has potential, but I'm not seeing it, over the last year we've had 

A move from dedicated servers to peer to peer (doesn't bother me, it works fine)

1 New heavy weapon (Rocket Rocket Launcher)

A weapon attachment system that is somehow worse than back 4 blood, instead of new weapons, the devs added weapon attachments that will be applied at random on weapons that spawn in the map, it's an interesting idea sure, but poorly implemented, especially when there's no way to carry over preferred attachments, even then a lot of the attachments make the guns feel worse and cosmetically look terrible.

For a simple game like this, I just wanted new weapons, like a marksman rifle, a simple single shot laser rifle would've been great and did exist at one point in one of the unfinished maps and then went no where!

Mod support which is great, although it's still in the early days and closed off in a beta stage so it's still got a lot of work before it goes fully public

One new episode in an unfinished state which fun fact, was already in the game including episode 5 at the start of the early access launch, it could be accessed via the console and not a lot has changed between the original version and the live version now outside of some object placements

16 achievements involving a barrel...

So for a TL:DR
Not a lot really happened in a year



It's a real shame, I like this game, it has that potential to fill the left 4 dead void, but it's starting to remind me of earthfall 


-- THIS WAS THE ORIGINAL REVIEW --

This game pretty much follows the formula of left 4 dead exactly.

4 survivors getting from point a to point b shooting the hell out of a bunch of aliens.

The replay value for this game is pretty good, it's a nice casual game to play while talking to friends and if you want more of a challenge there's the weekly challenge mode and also the weekly challenges from the season pass (don't worry there's no microtransactions!)

The Anacrusis has potential to fill the void left 4 dead has formed over the years so yeah, once it's closer to the end of early access I'd highly recommend this game

Plus it's getting mod support soon, so if you wanted someone like left 4 dead this is perfect potential
I like the whole concept of a L4D-styled co-op FPS game set in 1960s-70s sci fi. Tho it kinda needs a little work since it's Early Access yet.
